goal: Let RPC callers optionally receive feerates in sat/vB instead of BTC/kvB
Eliminates external unit conversions and prevents sub-sat calculation errors in tooling
agreement: Support for migrating to sat/vB in a backwards-compatible manner (musaHaruna)
Concerns over floating-point precision, header dependencies, and bucket units were resolved (maflcko, w0xlt)
Objection to changing defaults in the future settled by agreeing to keep BTC/kvB default (glozow)
Approved after earlier technical issues were fixed (w0xlt)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it resolves an interface inconvenience for callers expecting modern sat/vB units
Unit conversion remains a deferrable convenience rather than core missing functionality
